row.notes: Calendar vector at param_1+8..+0x10 (0x10-byte start/end timestamp pairs). For index < count returns the summed durations of entries 0..index inclusive, each = round((difftime(end,start) via 0x145347970 + 86400)/86400) days * 0x5a0 (1440 min); 0 if out of range. Not the start minute of the entry. (lane owner review requested) Better name: Career_Calc_CalendarMinutesThroughEntry (bound record keeps its name).

verify.notes: V9648 Returns cumulative minutes (days*0x5a0 summed) of entries 0..index inclusive, i.e. the end of the entry, not its start.
